changes: Localized lower-temple hair tuck: up to 16 mm posterior and 7 mm inward, preserving upper temple coverage, ear size, face, body and textures
Fixed 60 Hz pose and spring simulation; converted per-step damping, stiffness and gravity; softer distal hair
Adaptive drawing: up to 60 FPS for gestures/settling and 30 FPS idle; bounded catch-up and hidden pause
Staggered reach/hold/recovery, preserved pose velocity, asymmetric arm timing and wrist follow-through
Individual relaxed finger curls, restrained spread and thumb articulation
Smooth conservative contact shell around nine runtime ellipsoids, including scalp protection while springs are frozen
Studio movement-speed control from 0.65 to 1.50 times normal tempo

validation.slow_fast_comparison: World-space hair tips swing farther from turn axis on a 1.5x twirl than on a 0.65x twirl
validation.performance_scope: Short native WebKit test only; JS timings measure CPU update and draw submission, not GPU execution or full-app thermal/multitasking cost

limitations: Guide-chain approximation with padded body contact, no strand self-collision or deforming cloth solver
Gesture and hair response are stylized and not physically calibrated
Runtime hair-contact shader and lit cardigan-color hook are app-specific
Reference asymmetric fringe, painterly waves, face structure and garment drape still differ
Offline changes are baked into the VRM, not a new editable VRoid project
Sustained voice-plus-renderer multitasking cost has not been benchmarked
